title: Saved my engine during a low-speed slide in Leh!
comment: Installed this before my Ladakh trip. Took a spill on slush near Zoji La. Guard took the full impact, not a scratch on the engine casing or tank! Worth every single rupee.

title: Night visibility upgraded tenfold!
comment: Cruising through Western Ghats fog with yellow beam on is an absolute game-changer. Sharp cutoff line means oncoming traffic isn't blinded.

title: Sleek carbon finish & super light
comment: Fits snug and wind noise is well controlled up to 120km/h. Pinlock visor works flawlessly in heavy rain.
